notes: Movement formations (docs/behavior-lab/03 §6). A template places the roles of one unit (`slots`) and its child units (`elements`, in the organization's order). Offsets are `forward` and `right` of the unit's reference point.

Units: a template without elements measures its slots in individual intervals (d); a template with elements measures its slots and elements in element spacings (D). Both are chosen when the formation is built (defaults d = 10 m, D = 2 d).
A slot is held by the first unassigned member whose role is listed; members left over follow in file at the rear.
`mirror` (default true): placed left of its parent's reference line, the unit is mirrored, so leaders are on the side nearest their parent's leader, as the doctrinal figures draw them.
Geometry follows the doctrinal figures, which give relative positions only; the numbers (stagger, column spacing, element spacings) are Ambush! tuning choices.

templates.name: Wedge
templates.doctrine: MCRP 3-10A.4 (2020) Fig 1-12; MCWP 3-11.2 Fig 3-2: rifleman at the point, team leader and grenadier (AAR) on the shoulders, automatic rifleman at the rear.

templates.name: Column
templates.doctrine: MCRP 3-10A.4 (2020) Fig 1-11; MCWP 3-11.2 Fig 3-1: rifleman, team leader, automatic rifleman, grenadier (AAR), slightly staggered.

templates.name: File
templates.doctrine: MCRP 3-10A.4 (2020) Fig 1-11 without the stagger: one behind another.

templates.name: Skirmishers
templates.doctrine: MCRP 3-10A.4 (2020) Fig 1-13; MCWP 3-11.2 Fig 3-3: a staggered line (the fire teams of a squad line).

templates.name: Wedge (US Army)
templates.doctrine: ATP 3-21.8 (2024) paras 3-46, 3-47, Fig 3-2; FM 3-21.8 (2007) para 3-34: team leader at the point, automatic rifleman and grenadier echeloned behind either side, rifleman at the rear; interval normally 10 m.

templates.name: Wedge
templates.doctrine: A three-Marine wedge: the leader at the point, the others echeloned behind either side (after the fire-team wedge, ATP 3-21.8 Fig 3-2).

templates.name: File
templates.doctrine: One behind another, the leader first.

templates.name: Wedge
templates.doctrine: MCRP 3-10A.4 (2020) Fig 1-16: 1st team at the point, the squad leader just behind it, 2nd and 3rd teams behind on the left and right; teams in wedge.

templates.name: Column
templates.doctrine: MCRP 3-10A.4 (2020) Fig 1-15; MCWP 3-11.2: teams one behind another, the squad leader just behind the lead team; teams in column.

templates.name: Line
templates.doctrine: MCRP 3-10A.4 (2020) Fig 1-18: 3rd, 1st and 2nd teams abreast, left to right, the squad leader behind the centre; teams as skirmishers.

templates.name: File
templates.doctrine: The squad in single file (MCRP 3-10A.4 squad column with teams in file): 1st team, the squad leader, 2nd team, 3rd team.
